run_metadata.audit_scope: Metadata-only evidence-sufficiency and search-coverage audit; not full-text eligibility screening or extraction.

rubric.scope_rule: Each label is based only on saved title, saved abstract/snippet, and Scopus/IEEE provenance. It is not a full-text fact, final Route A/B decision, or extracted RQ1 datum.

signal_levels.direct_metadata_signal: The saved metadata visibly contains the dimension-specific terms/relationship prescribed below. It is a retrieval lead, not proof of the full-text protocol threshold.
signal_levels.plausible_full_text_lead: The metadata or primary-source discovery provenance makes the dimension worth checking, but the required detail/relationship is not visible.
signal_levels.no_visible_evidence: The saved title/abstract provides no dimension-specific signal. It means metadata silence only, not source absence.

dimensions.model_representation: Direct requires co-visible EPS content plus a structured-system-model/MBSE term. Qualifying-relation direct additionally requires a visible relation/analysis/traceability term. A full-text EPS anchor, model anchor, and reconstructable bridge remain mandatory.
dimensions.purpose: Direct requires visible task/decision/lifecycle language. EPS-specific purpose additionally requires co-visible EPS content; generic purpose is not treated as EPS purpose.
dimensions.inputs_assumptions: Input topic, explicit model-input/assumption wording, value/unit/time, provenance, uncertainty/margin, rationale, trace location, and effect are scored separately. Named EPS topics do not become reported inputs by inference.
dimensions.abstraction: Direct requires visible conceptual/logical/functional/black-box/fidelity/parametric/reference/template/metamodel-style vocabulary. Omission evidence requires an explicit omission/boundary statement, not generic constraints.
dimensions.reuse_tailoring: Mechanism/asset/context are separate from demonstrated versus intended. An asset or application phrase is not treated as independent reuse or EPS-thread reuse without full text.

query_coverage.search_discoverability_vs_evidence: A query hit and source provenance establish discoverability only. Metadata signals establish only what is visible in title/snippet. Synthesis answerability remains dependent on full-text eligibility and extraction.

probe_results.decision: No probe result was merged into the canonical candidates or corpus. No new plausible candidate was found; no refinement beyond the manageable 2–3-query batches was warranted.

verdicts.component: Model representation and qualifying EPS-thread relations
verdicts.evidence: Both primary sources used explicit EPS Stream-A routes; 14/92 kept records are A-tagged and 78/92 are B-only embedded-thread leads. The audit finds direct metadata relation signals in only two kept records, so metadata cannot establish the full protocol bridge.
verdicts.limits: A direct metadata relation signal is not a Route A/B eligibility decision. 61/92 records have no saved abstract and the other 31 abstracts are truncated.

verdicts.component: Stated purposes, decisions, and lifecycle use
verdicts.evidence: Task/lifecycle language is broadly visible across the kept set and the primary query set explicitly covers requirements, behavior, architecture, interfaces, traceability, parametrics, verification/validation, analysis, and concurrent/conceptual design.
verdicts.limits: Most visible purpose language is system-level rather than demonstrably EPS-specific; only nine kept records have a direct EPS-plus-purpose metadata signal, so full text must attach purposes to eligible EPS threads.

verdicts.evidence: Original Stream-A functional EPS/budget/component queries plus the new direct inputs/assumptions probes are redundant with frozen candidates. Candidate leads include budgets, energy, power consumption, resources, operational scenarios, batteries/solar content, and constraints.
verdicts.limits: Only one kept record visibly calls out a model input/parameter relationship under the predeclared rule; topic words are not evidence that a field was reported or material to a decision.

verdicts.component: Input values/units/time basis, provenance, uncertainty/margins, rationale, trace location, and effect
verdicts.evidence: The targeted assumptions/margins/orbit/environment probe found no new plausible candidate, so direct discoverability is tested. However, saved metadata almost never discloses these extraction-level details; the audit detects no visible EPS value/unit and no source-locatable input trace.
verdicts.limits: This is an answerability risk, not a finding of absence in full text. It can only be resolved by source-located extraction without inference.

verdicts.evidence: Reference-model, conceptual, logical/functional architecture, black-box, parametric, and fidelity vocabulary occurs in kept metadata; the direct abstraction/fidelity probes returned only frozen records.
verdicts.limits: Most signals are generic system-model signals rather than visibly EPS-specific choices; full text must establish the EPS model boundary and fidelity.

verdicts.component: Deliberate omissions and explicit boundary exclusions
verdicts.evidence: No saved metadata directly identifies a deliberately omitted phenomenon or an explicit EPS model-boundary exclusion under the strict rule.
verdicts.limits: Metadata silence cannot prove full-text absence, but omission comparison cannot be assumed from generic constraints or model labels.

verdicts.evidence: The newly direct reuse/tailoring probes returned 90 fully retrieved source occurrences across Scopus/IEEE, overwhelmingly frozen duplicates and no new plausible candidate. Kept metadata contains reference-model, template, profile, open-source, tailored, and standardization signals.
verdicts.limits: Most mechanisms are generic CubeSat/system-level and a large share sits in the named reference-model title family. EPS-specific reuse/tailoring is sparse in metadata.

verdicts.evidence: Metadata more often describes an asset, intended starting point, template, or mechanism than an independently demonstrated reuse instance. The reference-model title family contributes a concentrated share of the reuse signals.
verdicts.limits: Metadata-level application wording cannot prove independent reuse, transfer, tailoring steps, or an EPS-thread result; full-text evidence and lineage handling are essential.

recommendations.recommendation: Proceed to the protocol-defined full-text eligibility pilot, starting with all six core candidates and the direct-signal supporting leads. For every retained Route A/B thread, source-locate EPS anchor, model anchor, and bridge before counting it as RQ1 evidence.

Use the protocol input/assumption form verbatim for values/units/time basis, provenance, uncertainty/margin, rationale, trace location, and effect. Preserve not_reported rather than inferring these fields from a budget, simulation, or model label.

Separate generic CubeSat/system-model reuse from EPS-thread reuse. Treat the CubeSat reference-model title family as a clustered lineage, not independent replications, and distinguish intended assets from applied/reused instances.
Use the audit-probe files only as isolated coverage evidence; do not merge them. Their zero new-plausible yield does not justify changing the frozen corpus or eligibility criteria.

After full-text inclusions exist, perform the protocol-required iterative citation chasing and document any evidence-window update separately. That future step, not metadata-only auditing, is the appropriate route for residual recall risk.
